name: Baby Elon
rootCause: The Baby Elon project on BNBChain had a rug pull on June 8, and they took 623 BNB (~$179,000) and quickly moved the funds to Tornado Cash.

descriptions.text: The Baby Elon project on BNBChain had a rug pull on June 8, and they took 623 BNB (~$179,000) and quickly moved the funds to Tornado Cash.
A Rug Pull occurred on the project BabyElon on BNB Chian, the token dropped 98%, and the scammers have transferred 623 BNB to Tornado Cash, with a loss of about $180,000.
